editorial.thesis: A motor-trade-and-trading city of about 1.2 million. Its retail is heavy on grocery & daily needs and restaurants & fast food, and thin on fitness & wellness and banks & atms — and 69% of residents live in zones with under 60% of the city's average retail depth.
takeaways: Branded retail is about 73% of Visakhapatnam's. 25.62 chain outlets per lakh residents against 35.21 in Visakhapatnam; 36 of the 51 national brands we track are present, led by Apollo Pharmacy 72, MedPlus 52, Reliance Trends 28.

The mapped economy leans to grocery & daily needs. Shares of all mapped places: grocery & daily needs 3.8% (Visakhapatnam 2.6%); malls & department stores 1.0% (Visakhapatnam 0.8%); leisure & entertainment 2.1% (Visakhapatnam 3.3%); hotels & stays 4.3% (Visakhapatnam 5.7%). Raw counts would mislead because Visakhapatnam is mapped less completely (12,251 places against 12,517), so we compare mix, not counts.
Supply and demand are misaligned. 8 zones hold 69% of residents with under 60% of the city's average retail depth. Autonagar alone has about 195,000 residents and 60 mapped food & drink places.

Retail is more concentrated than in Visakhapatnam. 52% of commercial places sit in the busiest tenth of the city (Visakhapatnam 49%). The largest cores are Moghalrajpuram · Punnamathota (1,414 places) and Civil Coursts · Buckinghampet (1,078).

The widest brand gaps against Visakhapatnam. Apollo Pharmacy 72 outlets vs 112; Spencer's 2 outlets vs 9; Bata 9 outlets vs 15. These are leads to check against live listings, not verdicts: a brand may trade under another name or have opened since the map was updated.

numbers.title: The city in eight numbers
numbers.deck: A 8 km circle around the centre, processed with the same rules as Visakhapatnam, so every comparison is like for like. Where raw counts would mislead — because a bigger city is mapped more completely — we compare shares and mix instead.

map.title: Where people live, where shops are
map.deck: Switch layers. The amber “gap” layer is the one to study: it marks places with many residents but little retail around them. Hover any hexagon (about 0.1 km²) for its numbers; click a zone on the right to isolate it.

captions.residents: Where people live. Autonagar and Moghalrajpuram · Punnamathota are the largest zones by residents (195,000 and 149,000). Modelled residents per square kilometre.
captions.supply: Where the shops are. The busiest tenth of cells hold 52% of all commercial places, and Moghalrajpuram · Punnamathota alone lists 1,414.
captions.chains: Where the brands are. Moghalrajpuram · Punnamathota holds 69 of the 304 tracked chain outlets, and Autonagar adds 27.
captions.education: Where the campuses are. Moghalrajpuram · Punnamathota and Autonagar lead on education places (235 and 76, with 67 and 19 coaching centres) — a daytime youth market that residents alone do not show.
captions.gap: The gap. Amber: many residents nearby, little retail. Blue: far more retail than local residents explain — the commercial cores that draw people in. The deepest amber sits in Autonagar and Wnchipet. The blue cores include Moghalrajpuram · Punnamathota.

zones.title: Zone by zone, by PIN code
zones.deck: Each zone is a postal-code area. Residents are modelled counts; places are mapped businesses and services. “Retail depth” is places per 10,000 residents — the tick marks the city average. Click a row to see it on the map.

mix.title: What the retail layer is made of
mix.deck: Raw counts per resident would favour whichever city is mapped more completely (12,251 places in Visakhapatnam against 12,517 here). So this compares each category's share of all mapped places. 100 means the same share as Visakhapatnam; below 100 is thinner, above is stronger.
mix.note: Against Visakhapatnam, Vijayawada's mapped places over-index on grocery & daily needs (3.8% vs 2.6%), malls & department stores (1.0% vs 0.8%), automotive (4.5% vs 3.6%) and under-index on leisure & entertainment (2.1% vs 3.3%), hotels & stays (4.3% vs 5.7%), other services (5.4% vs 6.6%).

chains.title: Who is mapped here, and who is not
chains.deck: 304 outlets of 36 tracked national brands within 8 km — 25.62 per lakh residents against Visakhapatnam's 35.21 (322 outlets of 36 brands). Filled names have at least one mapped outlet (count shown); dashed names have none.
chains.note: Read dashed names as leads, not verdicts. “No mapped outlet” can mean a brand trades under a different listed name, or has opened since the map was updated. The widest gaps against Visakhapatnam are Apollo Pharmacy (72 vs 112); Spencer's (2 vs 9); Bata (9 vs 15). Premium reports check every lead against live listings.

formats.title: Which formats have room
formats.deck: 9 formats, thinnest first. The index is the format's share of all mapped places relative to Visakhapatnam's, so low means thin by Visakhapatnam's standard. “Where to look” ranks zones with at least 40,000 residents by residents per mapped outlet — a first-pass screen for where one more outlet would face the least local competition.

people.title: Who the customers are
people.deck: Age mix inside the 8 km circle, from Meta's age rasters (modelled, not a census).
people.note: Vijayawada's age mix against Visakhapatnam: children (0–14) 19.7% vs 21.4%, 15–24 19.7% vs 18.8%, working age 50.2% vs 51.0%, 60+ 10.4% vs 8.8%. Under-25s are 39% of residents.

restaurants.read: Restaurants & fast food are 6.1% of mapped places against 4.9% in Visakhapatnam — above its share. Mapped chain outlets: KFC 18 (Visakhapatnam 14), Domino's 12 (Visakhapatnam 11), Pizza Hut 8 (Visakhapatnam 8), Wow! Momo 3 (Visakhapatnam 1). No mapped outlet in either city: Haldiram's, Biryani By Kilo, Faasos.
restaurants.watch: Independent eateries are numerous and unevenly mapped. Treat the index as a screen and confirm competitor density street by street.

cafes.read: Cafés, tea & coffee are 2.0% of mapped places against 1.7% in Visakhapatnam — above its share. Mapped chain outlets: Café Coffee Day 8 (Visakhapatnam 11), Starbucks 1 (Visakhapatnam 1), Chai Point 1 (Visakhapatnam 0). No mapped outlet in either city: Chaayos, Chai Sutta Bar, Blue Tokai, Third Wave Coffee.
cafes.watch: Chai stalls and independent cafés are under-mapped. A café concept here competes on price and habit as much as on novelty.

desserts.read: Desserts, sweets & ice cream are 0.9% of mapped places against 1.0% in Visakhapatnam, so the mix is level. Mapped chain outlets: Baskin Robbins 5 (Visakhapatnam 5), Naturals 2 (Visakhapatnam 4), Cream Stone 2 (Visakhapatnam 1). No mapped outlet in either city: Theobroma.
desserts.watch: Traditional sweet shops are the real benchmark and sit outside most chain lists.

grocery.read: Grocery & daily needs are 3.8% of mapped places against 2.6% in Visakhapatnam — above its share. Mapped chain outlets: DMart 10 (Visakhapatnam 6), Reliance Smart / Fresh 10 (Visakhapatnam 7), Spencer's 2 (Visakhapatnam 9), Vishal Mega Mart 2 (Visakhapatnam 0). No mapped outlet in either city: Easyday, Star Bazaar.
grocery.watch: Neighbourhood kirana stores are the real incumbents and the least completely mapped outlets, so any gap is overstated. Test a site against local store density before acting.

pharmacy.read: Pharmacy & health retail are 1.8% of mapped places against 1.9% in Visakhapatnam, so the mix is level. Mapped chain outlets: Apollo Pharmacy 72 (Visakhapatnam 112), MedPlus 52 (Visakhapatnam 35). No mapped outlet in either city: Wellness Forever, Frank Ross.
pharmacy.watch: Independent chemists are dense and lightly mapped. Hospital and clinic clusters are the natural anchors.

apparel.read: Apparel, footwear & jewellery are 6.5% of mapped places against 5.7% in Visakhapatnam — above its share. Mapped chain outlets: Reliance Trends 28 (Visakhapatnam 22), Raymond 9 (Visakhapatnam 10), Bata 9 (Visakhapatnam 15), Shoppers Stop 8 (Visakhapatnam 1).
apparel.watch: Established multi-brand traders and local bazaars sit behind these numbers; new entrants compete with them as well as with chains.

banking.read: Banks & ATMs are 7.7% of mapped places against 8.2% in Visakhapatnam, so the mix is level.
banking.watch: This category includes insurance and agency offices, so it overstates branch banking. Use it as a signal of commercial activity, not a branch count.

coaching.read: Coaching & training are 1.4% of mapped places against 1.4% in Visakhapatnam, so the mix is level.
coaching.watch: Coaching demand follows the exam calendar. Formats that depend on it should be tested across the academic year.

fitness.read: Fitness & wellness are 2.2% of mapped places against 3.1% in Visakhapatnam — below its share.
fitness.watch: Gym listings change often and are inconsistently categorised; verify before drawing conclusions.
